Groq._ApiKey: Set via user-secrets (AiSettings:Groq:ApiKey) locally, or AiSettings__Groq__ApiKey in the container. Never commit a value here.

Gemini._ApiKey: Set via user-secrets (AiSettings:Gemini:ApiKey) locally, or AiSettings__Gemini__ApiKey in the container. Never commit a value here.

Security._SharedSecret: Set via user-secrets (AiSettings:Security:SharedSecret) locally, or AiSettings__Security__SharedSecret in the container. Must match the gateway's AiServiceSettings:SharedSecret. Startup fails if unset.
